name: Bückeburg (Germany)
description: Horizontal tricolour of white, red and blue, charged at the centre with the city arms of Bückeburg (a red gate with towers on white under a mural crown).
history: Municipal flag of Bückeburg; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Bückeburg arms — red gate with mural crown
